subject: design/impl-review-source-write-guard
statement: This guard establishes filesystem write ownership. It does not establish a host read allowlist, prevent reading arbitrary host files, restrict network destinations, or protect against another process running as the same OS user. Native permission flags must not be represented as those additional guarantees.
